title: Demo game made with AI in Unity
author: BAIZOR
selftext:
# [AI Game Developer](https://ai-game.dev)
Almost 100% made with AI in AI Game Developer
Here is what AI had made:
- Animations (landing / launching)
- Ship controller
- Camera controller
- Particle Systems
- Post Processing setup
- Materials linking

comments.author: cenderius
comments.body: more detail ? sea and snowish weather made with ai ? no assets used from store ?

replies.author: BAIZOR
replies.body:
Assets were used of course, the spaceship with the texture is an asset for example. But the spaceship didn’t had animations. AI added animator with 4 animation states and 4 animation clips, linked all together with GameObjects, C#, Materials. It made new materials to link the texture for the 3D model of the spaceship.

It made the particle system of the feathers in the air. It used a single texture of the feather from assets. 

It added the ocean, which is just a single GameObjects from the assets, nothing cool here.

It also made the controller code for mouse and keyboard to control the ship and the camera.

What else…? Hm… don’t remember, probably I forgot something.

comments.author: HideousSerene
comments.body:
Ah, very cool, this is on my list of tech to try out. I'm coming from a web dev background and so I've been using cursor with Unity and, well, it's been interesting. 

I feel like all these visual tools and whatnot are just a pain and having AI be able to rapidly configure a scene of game objects feels like a really good thing. Personally, I would rather see game dev move towards purely serialized code based tools (not reliant on visual editors) rather than MCP wrappers.

I find GPT tends to want to update my unity meta files (not sure what they're called, but the files that track scene definitions) whereas something like Opus less so. If I give your tool a try, what provider seems to be most knowledgeable about using the unity MCP?

replies.author: BAIZOR
replies.body:
I would say Claude Code with Opus is the best one. 
Also technically any provider is good, because my tool provides knowledge to any of them. Close Code is just the most stable
